name: Decide what to do with a condition
description: Learn how a Condition splits a workflow into two paths. The workflow gets the current weather in Zagreb from the free Open-Meteo API, checks whether it is raining and writes a different message to the log for each case. It runs with one click and needs no connection.
shortDescription: Learn how a Condition sends a workflow down one of two paths.
keyFeatures: Compare a number from an earlier step with a fixed value
Run different steps on the True and False paths
Read fields from a JSON response of a public API
idealFor: First-time ByteChef users who want to learn how a workflow makes decisions before building their own.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Test in the workflow editor.
Get the current weather: an HTTP GET to the free Open-Meteo API returns the current temperature and rain in Zagreb.
Is it raining?: a Condition checks whether ${httpClient_1.current.precipitation} is greater than 0.
True path: the Logger writes how much rain is falling. False path: the Logger writes that no umbrella is needed and the current temperature.
